thread:
eli: Left a box of scones on the island from The Tea Nook (11:50). One cinnamon, two plain, one raisin. Please only take one so there's some for the 2pm crowd.
maddie: bless you eli. does anyone have clotted cream or should we do butter?
zoe: I have a tiny tub of butter in the fridge labelled 'zoe 04/29' but no cream.
rahul: Not sure where the spoons are. I found a single fork and one plastic knife in the snack drawer.
paul: Spoon situation is tragic. I can run to the store in 15 if someone needs cream+spoons. Venmo?
eli: thanks paul but let's save a run. butter works. also FYI someone nuked a soggy napkin in the microwave; microwave smells weird. If you heat anything, please check first.
maddie: Oh no. who microwaved a napkin? :grimacing: Could we get a quick "microwave check" sign on the machine as a reminder?
zoe: I'll tape a small note to the microwave: "no paper towels/napkins alone".
rahul: kitchen-bot: quick question: is there a cleaning schedule for the microwave?
kitchen-bot: Kitchen Ops update: communal appliances should be wiped weekly. If you use the microwave for messy items, please wipe spills immediately. Also, label personal fridge items with "Name / Date / Keep?". Unlabeled perishables older than 96 hours will be cleared on Fridays.
paul: ok, I left a spare set of plastic teaspoons in the cutlery jar (top shelf) and labelled them "spoons - shared".
eli: also left a sticky note on the scone box with flavors/counts. Please respect labels + try to leave one for late snackers.
maddie: quick poll: should we keep napkins by the coffee station in a covered box to avoid microwave accidents? react :+1: yes :no_entry_sign: no.
zoe: :+1: covered napkins please.
rahul: :no_entry_sign: I'm fine with existing setup.
paul: :+1: covered napkins and a small jar of spare spoons.
eli: thanks team. microwave note taped, spoons restocked, scones disappearing fast :yum:. If you labeled something KEEP, please add a date as the bot said.
maddie: End thread — scone emergency averted :)
